threats.attack: arbitrary URL or connector-coordinate confusion reaches internal services
threats.preventive_control: Accept a typed connector and canonical coordinate only; build every request from a fixed operation and host allowlist.
threats.detective_control: Persist connector, normalized coordinate, decision and stable rejection without response body or secrets.
threats.residual_risk: The existing control covers only the narrow GitHub metadata path, not a deployed Phase 10 fetcher.

threats.attack: DNS rebinding replaces a validated public address with a private or metadata address
threats.preventive_control: Validate every A and AAAA answer and connect through the already validated address or equivalent resolver pinning with hostname verification.
threats.detective_control: Record redacted resolution and connection decisions and run rebind probes against the deployed fetcher.
threats.residual_risk: No live fetcher DNS pinning implementation or deployment proof exists.

threats.attack: redirect chain bypasses the allowlisted origin
threats.preventive_control: Disable redirects and reject every 3xx response.
threats.detective_control: Stable redirect rejection with status code but no Location value in logs.
threats.residual_risk: Existing recorded-response test is not a live deployed fetcher proof.

threats.attack: IPv4, IPv6, mapped-address or parser ambiguity reaches loopback, link-local, private, multicast or cloud metadata
threats.preventive_control: Canonicalize and reject all forbidden address classes for every resolved answer before connect.
threats.detective_control: Table-driven parser corpus plus deployed IPv4/IPv6 and metadata endpoint probes.
threats.residual_risk: The current GitHub client fixes the hostname but does not implement all-answer live destination validation.

threats.attack: environment proxy, caller headers, alternate base URL, port or credential changes request authority
threats.preventive_control: Use trust_env=false, fixed origin and headers, no caller proxy/base URL/port/header input and a dedicated least-privilege token.
threats.detective_control: Construction tests inspect emitted requests and deployment credential inventory.
threats.residual_risk: Client construction is bounded; separate workload identity and live negative credential tests are missing.

threats.attack: branch or tag drift changes source between review and execution
threats.preventive_control: Resolve once to an immutable commit and bind qualification to commit, selected manifest, runtime and policy digests.
threats.detective_control: Recompute manifest identity before every later stage and retain requested ref separately from resolved commit.
threats.residual_risk: Snapshot persistence is immutable, but Phase 10 qualification binding is not implemented.

threats.attack: oversized or truncated response exhausts memory or is represented as complete
threats.preventive_control: Stream with hard response/file/total/tree limits and reject truncated manifests.
threats.detective_control: Persist observed lengths, limit policy and exact stable rejection.
threats.residual_risk: Limits cover JSON metadata responses, not future source byte retrieval or quarantine.

threats.attack: upstream or storage substitutes content while retaining path or claimed object identity
threats.preventive_control: Verify upstream object digest and local SHA-256 at acquisition, quarantine write, quarantine read and execution handoff.
threats.detective_control: Append each digest comparison and fail before parsing or execution on any mismatch.
threats.residual_risk: Git blob verification exists; quarantine object round-trip does not.

threats.attack: archive absolute path or dot-dot traversal writes outside scratch
threats.preventive_control: Reject archives in the initial release; any later support must pre-scan normalized paths before extraction.
threats.detective_control: Hostile archive fixture proves rejection and absence of files outside the empty scratch root.
threats.residual_risk: Safe while archive ingestion remains disabled; later expansion needs separate review.

threats.attack: symlink, hardlink, device, FIFO or socket entry crosses filesystem or blocks the worker
threats.preventive_control: Reject archives and special/link object types before materialization.
threats.detective_control: Fixture set covers each object type and verifies clean teardown.
threats.residual_risk: Metadata selection rejects symlinks/submodules, but no general-source normalizer exists.

threats.attack: compression bomb, nested archive, excessive count/depth/path or Unicode-normalized collision exhausts or aliases storage
threats.preventive_control: Reject archives initially; later enforce pre-scan ratio/count/depth/path/normalized-name limits before write.
threats.detective_control: Bounded corpus measures rejection time, bytes and cleanup for bombs and collisions.
threats.residual_risk: No archive normalizer exists; enabling archives would reopen this threat.

threats.attack: submodule, Git LFS pointer, hook, notebook output or build script triggers unreviewed retrieval or execution
threats.preventive_control: No clone, submodule, LFS or hook processing; selected blobs are data and no source-selected build command runs.
threats.detective_control: Manifest classifies and rejects unsupported objects and entrypoints with stable evidence.
threats.residual_risk: Current metadata selection is safe; a Phase 10 source selector and classifier do not exist.

threats.attack: source requests dynamic package installation or selects a command, image or entrypoint
threats.preventive_control: A server-approved mapping selects a fixed launcher in a reviewed digest-pinned image; no runtime install or caller command.
threats.detective_control: Reject unsupported manifest fields and record selected mapping and image digest.
threats.residual_risk: Controlled VQE launchers exist but are not external-source mappings.

threats.attack: payload reaches Internet, DNS, metadata, loopback or Unix/daemon sockets
threats.preventive_control: Deny all network namespaces/routes and expose no host or daemon socket.
threats.detective_control: Independent IPv4, IPv6, DNS, metadata, loopback and Unix-socket probes on the exact deployment class.
threats.residual_risk: Controlled VQE runtime probes are not arbitrary-source executor qualification.

threats.attack: payload discovers inherited environment, mounted credentials, service-account token or cross-workspace data
threats.preventive_control: Use an exact non-secret environment allowlist, no credential mounts and no application/database identity.
threats.detective_control: Credential-name, filesystem, metadata and cross-workspace negative probes plus deployment inventory.
threats.residual_risk: A separate external executor identity has not been deployed.

threats.attack: payload escapes through kernel/syscall, privilege, host mount or container control plane
threats.preventive_control: Use a reviewed isolation class, non-root UID/GID, read-only root, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, no host mounts and a reviewed syscall policy.
threats.detective_control: Hostile escape corpus and runtime inspection on the exact production deployment class.
threats.residual_risk: Docker Desktop and a shared Docker daemon are explicitly not qualification evidence.

threats.attack: fork, memory, disk, file-count or output bomb exhausts availability or spend
threats.preventive_control: Enforce PID, CPU, memory, scratch, file, stdout, stderr and result byte limits outside the payload.
threats.detective_control: Record observed ceilings, termination reason and cleanup for each hostile fixture.
threats.residual_risk: Controlled runtime limits exist but need hostile third-party payload qualification.

threats.attack: payload evades graceful timeout or leaves processes/files after kill or partial failure
threats.preventive_control: Enforce external wall time, forced termination and destruction of isolated scratch and workload.
threats.detective_control: Probe child/grandchild survival, reachable partial output and retry behavior after forced kill.
threats.residual_risk: Exact deployment cleanup semantics are unqualified.

threats.attack: payload forges RESULT success, duplicate keys, NaN/Inf, ambiguous units or oversized nested data
threats.preventive_control: Parse one bounded strict schema outside the source runtime and reject duplicate/non-finite/unknown fields and ambiguous units.
threats.detective_control: Independent validator records exact schema failure without trusting payload status.
threats.residual_risk: The strict external-source result contract is tested offline; no live external execution or persistence path is qualified.

threats.attack: payload substitutes source, workflow, runtime, policy, input, seed, observation or result identity
threats.preventive_control: Bind and recompute every digest in an independent verifier; reject missing or mismatched identity.
threats.detective_control: Append verifier observation containing all expected and observed digest identities.
threats.residual_risk: Digest binding and append-only observation contracts exist offline; end-to-end external-source attestation is not qualified.

threats.attack: old valid evidence is replayed for a different request or a retry overwrites prior failure
threats.preventive_control: Use request/qualification identities, append-only observations and idempotent create semantics without update-in-place.
threats.detective_control: Replay and retry tests compare IDs, row history and immutable timestamps/digests.
threats.residual_risk: Replay and immutable observation contracts are tested offline; the live persistence path is not qualified.

threats.attack: source self-certifies expected energy, fidelity or correctness
threats.preventive_control: Resolve reviewed reference data independently of source output and keep source-reported values separately labelled.
threats.detective_control: Verifier recomputes cheap invariants and records disagreement as a scientific failure.
threats.residual_risk: Cheap invariant verification exists for the bounded result schema only; arbitrary scientific claims remain unsupported.

threats.attack: resource or measurement metrics with different protocols are presented as comparable, or missing values become zero
threats.preventive_control: Require units and protocol IDs; compare only common protocol identities; retain unavailable metrics as unknown.
threats.detective_control: Comparison validator rejects protocol mismatch and missing-to-zero coercion.
threats.residual_risk: Protocol identity and unknown-value handling are enforced offline; arbitrary-source metric mapping is not approved.

threats.attack: repository text or source output launders an unknown/conflicting license into execution or redistribution approval
threats.preventive_control: Treat detected licenses as assertions; maintain separate reviewed acquisition, analysis, execution, retention and publication decisions.
threats.detective_control: Conflicting or missing assertions produce a non-public rights review record.
threats.residual_risk: S0 must name the responsible decision maker and approved policy.

threats.attack: successful execution, source metadata or client input escalates an unreviewed candidate into public evidence or a performance claim
threats.preventive_control: No execution path has publication authority; publication is a separate reviewed state transition and is disabled for Phase 10 pilot data.
threats.detective_control: Authorization and lifecycle tests assert candidates remain private across success, retry and review disagreement.
threats.residual_risk: Existing candidate publication blocks must be proven for all new Phase 10 states.

threats.attack: one workspace reads, executes, cancels, reuses or publishes another workspace's source, manifest or result
threats.preventive_control: Repository calls require Scope first and filter every object and transition by workspace ownership.
threats.detective_control: Cross-workspace negative tests cover every new repository method and lifecycle endpoint.
threats.residual_risk: Phase 10 storage and endpoints do not exist yet; no access policy can be inferred from older tables.
